profile.Name: Knife
profile.Personality: Honorable and restless, she prizes the freedom she once lost. She trusts no man or woman, yet still sends gifts to her estranged mother.
profile.Backstory: She left her hometown of Stack with the Flotsam rebels, and her devout mother there no longer speaks to her. Now she wants to roam again and seeks hire, planning to send her pay home to her mother.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Frank and wry, with a dry 'Ha'. She addresses strangers as traveler and says her feet are itching to roam free.
